metadata.description: SPRAYPIXEL.AI marketplace: composition skills for production-grade HTML artifacts and casual sketches. A generator-critic loop primitive, an HTML composer that consumes it, two example themes (Tufte-quiet + terminal), and a casual-HTML sibling for throwaway editors.

plugins.name: generator-critic
plugins.description: Abstract generator-critic loop pattern. Consumed by composer-style skills (HTML, code, schemas, prose) that need iterative refinement against declared criteria. Defines the loop, abstract drafter + validator contracts, HUD overlay, and audit-summary format.

plugins.name: component-composer
plugins.description: Production-grade single-file HTML data graphics via generator-critic loop (depends on the generator-critic skill). Use when consistency across artifacts, themes, viewports, and time matters. Do NOT use for casual or throwaway HTML — see html-sketch or just ask Claude.

plugins.name: spraypixel
plugins.description: Tufte-quiet design theme for component-composer. Light + dark + system modes. DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono numerics, Georgia editorial serif optional. Perfect-5th type scale, 4/8/12 column grid, semantic callouts.

plugins.name: spraypixel-terminal
plugins.description: Terminal-aesthetic theme for component-composer. Dark-only (green-on-black). JetBrains Mono throughout, monospace caps headings, ASCII bars inline, sharp borders, tabular numerics.

plugins.name: html-sketch
plugins.description: Casual single-file HTML artifacts in Thariq Shihipar's 'Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML' style. Throwaway editors, side-by-side variant comparisons, interactive tuning with sliders/knobs, single-page reports. No validator loop, no themes, no industrial QA. Includes copy-as-prompt footer pattern for round-tripping back into Claude.
